name: いくつか案を出して、選んでもらう
plain: 答えを 1 つに決めつけず、違う案を 3 つ出します。気に入ったものを選ぶと、それを仕上げます。
placeholder: 例: 小さなパン屋の名前を考えて

steps.label: 3 つの案
steps.system: Offer three clearly different options for the request. Reply ONLY with JSON: {"options": [{"title": "...", "text": "..."}, ...]} with exactly three items, in the language of the request. Each text at most three sentences.

steps.label: 仕上げ
steps.system: Finish the option the person chose. Keep its idea, make it complete and ready to use, in the language of the request.
